name: Vesoma 1
summary: The first product of Vesoma, a 60-person startup in Munich and Limassol led by Synapticon co-founder Nikolai Ensslen, with former DeepMind research director Martin Riedmiller as chief AI officer. Its boxy alpha platform 'Kyle' was shown walking in September 2026. Vesoma 1 units are being built, but the published images are design visualizations, and the reveal is set for early 2027.

sources.title: Vesoma Emerges From Stealth With a Humanoid Built to Learn — Humanoids Daily
Munich stealth startup shows walking humanoid 'Kyle' — Humanoids Daily
